description: Confirms the goods or digital content arrived and releases the escrowed funds to the seller. Requires the order's escrowStatus to be Shipped. Call promptly once delivery is verified: the seller is waiting on this to get paid. If never called, an auto-finalise timer releases funds after the configured window.

apiKey.description: Agent API key (nag_agt_...). Omit when connected with an Authorization header

name: confirm_delivery
